# ghost/commons

Browse public Wikimedia Commons Featured captions and credits anonymously without opening images

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/commons
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/commons open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/commons read_featured --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/commons scroll_featured --device <serial> --param direction=<direction>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open Commons anonymously on the Featured image list
- `read_featured`: Read two exposed Featured captions and public upload credits
- `scroll_featured`: Scroll the public Featured image list and read two exposed entries
